claims: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run premiered on Netflix on March 19, 2026.
The first episode of JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run is ~47 minutes long.
JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run is released as an exclusive Netflix original net animation.
JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run is available worldwide.
JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run includes Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu dubs in India.
JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run is an adaptation of Part 7 of Hirohiko Araki's JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure manga.
JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run focuses on a horse race across the United States in the 19th century.
